papers.title_en: Exact Makespan Bounds and the GPipe Homogeneity Bias for Heterogeneous LLM Inference Pipelines
papers.evidence: 异构GPU上LLM流水线的精确工期分析
papers.tldr: 异构GPU上的大模型微批流水推理常沿用同构GPipe工期公式，因而难以准确判断吞吐瓶颈。论文以关键路径为核心，分别推导无通信、异步通信和阻塞通信下的精确完工时间。结果表明稳态斜率主要由最慢计算阶段决定，异步通信仅增加常数项，而阻塞通信可成为瓶颈。该工作量化了GPipe的同质性偏差，为异构流水切分和优化优先级提供了可验证依据。
papers.abstract_en: We give an exact critical-path characterization of the makespan of micro-batch pipelines serving LLMs on heterogeneous GPU clusters, quantifying how the classic homogeneous GPipe formula errs. In the pure-forward, communication-free, infinite-buffer setting, T(M) = (M-1)tau_max + Sum_j tau_j, where tau_j is stage j's per-micro-batch service time and M the micro-batch count (Theorem 1). Under asynchronous communication -- modern NCCL-based serving -- it extends to T(M) = Sum_j tau_j + Sum_j d_j + (M-1)tau_max, with Sum_j d_j a purely additive constant (Theorem 2); under blocking communication, T(M) = (M-1)sigma_max + Sum_s sigma_s with sigma_s = tau_s + d_s, so communication enters the steady-state slope iff some d_s > tau_max - tau_s (Theorem 3). These results quantify the GPipe overestimate, decompose the bias into a homogeneity term Sum_j (tau_max - tau_j) and a communication-ignoring term Sum_j d_j, and imply that balancing per-stage compute dominates communication reduction for steady-state throughput. A real system with partial overlap is sandwiched between Theorems 2 and 3, with a closed-form bound on the overlap throughput gain. All claims are validated pointwise (error < 10^-9) on eleven configurations and a 1.6x10^5-point fuzz, including a mixed RTX 5090/3090/GTX 1070 partition. We situate the results in flow-shop scheduling and list open extensions: bandwidth-limited communication, bounded buffers, prefill-decode interleaving.

papers.title_en: Stateful Testing for Deep Learning Compilers
papers.authors: Jiatao Ge, Ruixiang Qian, Yibo Hu, Yanzhou Mu, Yinglong Zou, Jiawei Liu, Zhenyu Chen, Chunrong Fang
papers.evidence: 面向PyTorch、JAX和TensorFlow编译器的有状态测试
papers.tldr: 深度学习编译器常以惰性方式编译并跨调用缓存产物，先前调用留下的状态会使原本独立正确的后续调用失效，传统单次测试难以发现。Rondo将测试表示为模型及调用序列，变异序列并以编译行为引导的马尔可夫链采样探索罕见行为，再以未编译、重置状态编译和保留状态编译的三路差分定位问题。它在四个框架、24类模型上发现117个缺陷，其中35个为有状态缺陷，报警精度99.26%。结果表明，面向调用历史的状态化测试可有效补足深度学习编译器测试。
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep learning compilers compile models lazily and cache artifacts across invocations. Retained compiler state can make a later invocation incorrect even when it is correct in isolation. An analysis of 26 publicly reported issues in PyTorch, JAX, and TensorFlow shows that detecting such bugs requires sequences that first establish compiler state and then expose a failure. We present Rondo, a stateful testing method that represents each test case as a model paired with an invocation sequence. Rondo mutates invocation sequences and uses a Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler guided by compilation behavior to favor rarely observed behaviors. Its three-way differential oracle compares execution without compilation, compiled execution with compiler state reset, and compiled execution with state retained. It confirms stateful bugs by replaying the same invocation with state retained and reset while preserving inputs and program state, then shortens sequences while preserving the original bug. We evaluate Rondo on four deep learning frameworks using 24 common model architectures. Rondo detects 117 bugs, including 35 stateful bugs. We submit 39 bug reports, including 18 for stateful bugs; developers confirm 35 reports, including 16 for stateful bugs, and fix 18 bugs, including 11 stateful bugs. Rondo achieves the highest behavior coverage and compiler Python source-line coverage among the compared methods, with 99.26% alarm precision. It shortens 44 of 117 invocation sequences, reducing the lengths of these 44 sequences by 83.34% on average.

papers.title_en: FlashRT-PAI: Fast Kernels Are Not Fast Pipelines for Physical AI Inference
papers.authors: Liang Su, David Chen, Jason Li, Kevin Guo, Teresa Lv
papers.evidence: 面向实时人工智能推理的模型硬件流水线协同设计
papers.tldr: 物理智能中的视觉—语言—动作、视频动作与世界动作模型，单批实时推理常受大量短核启动、中间数据搬运和跨决策重复计算制约，而非单核算力不足。FLASHRT-PAI以模型—硬件流水线协同设计替代孤立算子优化，通过深度融合、执行契约和状态胶囊降低端到端延迟。在RTX 5090与Jetson Thor上，其FP16较官方编译路径快1.3—3.7倍，结合低精度较官方即时执行快3.38—12.66倍。该工作证明跨调用状态复用与流水线全局优化是物理AI实时部署的关键，并已开源接入生态。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA), video-action (VA), and world action models (WAMs) form the backbone of modern physical AI systems, yet their real-time single-batch inference remains a defining bottleneck. Latency is dominated not by individual kernel computation, but by system-level overhead: thousands of short kernel launches, intermediate data movement across operator boundaries, and redundant recomputation across consecutive decisions. General-purpose graph compilers cannot address these costs, as they optimize individual calls in isolation and lack visibility into cross-call state semantics and global pipeline structure. We present FLASHRT-PAI, a low-latency inference engine built around model-hardware pipeline co-design rather than isolated kernel optimization. FLASHRT-PAI combines three core mechanisms: deep kernel fusion with launch overlap eliminates inter-operator boundaries and launch gaps; an execution contract formalizes the pipeline's stage DAG, update rates, and named buffers to enable cross-decision state reuse and selective refresh; and execution-state capsules enable fast snapshot, restore, and fork of persistent pipeline state. The system also supports drop-in acceleration of unmodified PyTorch models via parity- and latency-gated kernel replacement. Evaluation covers six policies on RTX 5090 and four on Jetson AGX Thor. At matched 16-bit precision, FLASHRT-PAI is 1.3-3.7x faster than official compiled paths. Combining pipeline co-design with reduced precision delivers 3.38-12.66x speedup over official eager implementations. In LIBERO-10, four-bit pi0.5 achieves 94.04% success on Thor and 93.32% on RTX 5090, compared with 92.4% for the measured official FP16 reference. FLASHRT-PAI is open source, distributed via Hugging Face Kernel Hub, and its opt-in pi0.5 kernels have been adopted into the LeRobot framework.

papers.title_en: MOSAIC: Multi-Objective Search for Allocating Inference Cache Across LLM Decoder Layers
papers.evidence: 通过逐层缓存分配优化LLM推理内存
papers.tldr: 长上下文推理中，KV缓存是主要显存瓶颈，但现有驱逐方法对所有解码层平均分配预算，忽略层间令牌需求差异。MOSAIC以多目标神经架构搜索学习逐层缓存预算，可在平均预算与任务得分间一次搜索并迁移到多种目标预算。它在154组配置中的146组优于均匀分配，最高提升RULER 48分，并可用至多四分之一缓存达到相同得分。该方法为不同驱逐策略提供可复用的层级资源分配机制，发现中间少数层最值得优先保留缓存。
papers.abstract_en: The Key-Value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck of long-context LLM inference. Token eviction methods such as SnapKV, H2O, AdaKV and L2Norm shrink it, but they give every transformer layer the same budget, although layers differ in which tokens they need. We present MOSAIC, a multi-objective neural architecture search that learns per-layer KV-cache budgets for any eviction method. One search maps the trade-off between average budget and task score; its best allocation transfers to every target budget without further search, and an optional budget-constrained search refines it. Across four eviction methods on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, MOSAIC beats uniform allocation in 146 of 154 (task, method, budget) settings, by up to +48 points on RULER and +11.9 on LongBench (LCC). On both models, it reaches the score of uniform allocation with up to 4x less KV cache (75% smaller). Against EvolKV, MOSAIC explores a ~10^40 x larger search space with 4x fewer evaluations and 18% fewer GPU-hours per budget, and scores higher in 5 of 6 settings. The learned allocations consistently favour a small set of middle layers.

papers.authors: Xidong Wu, Qi Qi, Yuqiong Ji, Shangqian Gao
papers.evidence: 通过异步训练框架消除轨迹生成瓶颈
papers.tldr: 在线策略自蒸馏让同一语言模型兼任学生与携带特权信息的教师，但同步生成轨迹成为训练扩展的主要瓶颈。AsyncOPSD将轨迹生成与学习器更新解耦，实现异步流水训练。针对旧策略轨迹滞后问题，它结合陈旧度感知的策略控制与词元级熵加权蒸馏目标。在三种模型规模和数学推理基准上，吞吐提升1.96—2.25倍且平均准确率提高，表明其可高效扩展自蒸馏训练。
papers.abstract_en: Unlike on-policy distillation (OPD), which depends on a separate teacher model, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a single language model acting simultaneously as the student and the teacher, with the teacher conditioned on privileged information. Despite this architectural simplicity, synchronous rollout generation dominates overall training time, creating a severe systems bottleneck when scaling OPSD. To address this, we introduce Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation (AsyncOPSD), a framework that decouples rollout generation from learner updates to improve training throughput. Since the teacher and student share parameters, AsyncOPSD eliminates the multi-model coordination overhead inherent to OPD architectures in asynchronous training. As the student policy evolves, buffered trajectories generated by older policies become stale, potentially degrading performance. To mitigate this, we introduce a distillation objective based on staleness-aware policy control and token-level entropy weighting. Across three model sizes and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, AsyncOPSD improves the training throughput by $1.96$--$2.25\times$ over synchronous OPSD while increasing average benchmark accuracy.

papers.title_en: Interflow: Breaking the Offline-Online Barrier for Private AI at the Edge
papers.authors: Hanieh Totonchi Asl, Ebrahim Nouri, Zhuoran Li, Danella Zhao
papers.evidence: 优化通信与内存的边缘私有AI推理基础设施
papers.tldr: 边缘端隐私保护机器学习依赖安全多方计算，但非线性推理中的相关随机数预生成会带来通信、计算、数据搬运与缓存压力，存储不足时还会反复停机补充。Interflow采用算法—硬件协同设计，按批次交错执行：当前批次消耗随机数完成在线计算，下一批次并行生成相关随机数。该方案将离线预处理转为持续流水线，在ZCU102上将非线性算子吞吐最高提升1.55倍，并显著降低模型端到端延迟和内存占用。
papers.abstract_en: Privacy-preserving machine learning (PPML) offers a promising path toward bringing powerful AI services to the edge without exposing sensitive user data. However, its practical deployment remains constrained by the high communication, computation, and data-movement costs of secure multi-party computation (MPC), particularly during nonlinear inference. Existing MPC systems typically decouple input-independent correlated randomness generation from online execution, creating substantial memory pressure to buffer single-use cryptographic data. Moreover, limited storage can force a stop-and-refill execution pattern that repeatedly stalls the pipeline to replenish these buffers, bringing randomness generation back onto the critical path. We propose Interflow, an algorithm-hardware co-design that rethinks this separation by batch-wise processing and pipelining correlated-randomness generation with online execution: while the current batch consumes pre-generated randomness to execute secure nonlinear operations, correlation generation proceeds concurrently for the next batch. By leveraging interleaved execution, efficient data movement, and hardware acceleration, the design transforms preprocessing from a serialized, storage-intensive offline phase into a continuously overlapped pipeline that generates correlated randomness closer to the point of consumption, reducing memory footprint and data movement overhead. Implemented on the Zynq UltraScale+ ZCU102, Interflow improves nonlinear evaluation throughput by up to 1.55x for CNN operators and 1.48x for transformer operators. It achieves up to 1.26x speedup for ResNet-50 and up to 1.21x speedup for BERT-base, and reduces memory footprint by up to 37%, compared with baseline frameworks.

papers.title_en: On Johnson-Lindenstrauss Transforms for Byzantine-Robust Optimization
papers.authors: Aleksandr Shestakov, Vladimir Aletov, Aleksandr Beznosikov
papers.evidence: 通信高效的拜占庭鲁棒分布式优化
papers.tldr: 大规模分布式学习中，通信压缩虽能降低开销，却可能削弱面对拜占庭恶意节点时的梯度聚合可靠性。论文将Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换用于压缩工作节点消息，并利用其高概率近似保持内积与距离的性质。鲁棒聚合器据此评估各消息与可信参考梯度的对齐程度并分配权重。理论分析与实验共同表明，该方案可兼顾低维通信、几何信息保留和拜占庭鲁棒优化。
papers.abstract_en: The growing scale of data and models in machine learning calls for efficient optimization methods. Distributed optimization addresses this challenge, with compression mechanisms helping to reduce communication costs. A classical tool for dimensionality reduction is the Johnson-Lindenstrauss (JL) transform, which is simple to implement and offers strong geometric guarantees. In particular, JL transforms approximately preserve inner products and pairwise distances between vectors with high probability. In this paper, we exploit this property in Byzantine-robust optimization, where worker messages are weighted according to their alignment with a trusted reference gradient. We further support our theoretical findings with experimental results.

papers.title_en: TrainBridge: Agentic NPU Training Optimization Guided by GPU Compilation Evidence
papers.authors: Yupeng Chen, Kunxiang Zhao, Xingjian Wang, Yue Zhao, Yijing Wu, Ye Liu, Kai Li, Congliang Chen, Ruoyu Sun
papers.evidence: 编译证据引导的NPU训练优化
papers.tldr: Ascend NPU训练中，算子融合等框架编译优化往往未充分生效，导致计算碎片化与额外执行开销，依赖人工剖析调优成本高。TrainBridge将成熟GPU编译栈产生的高效执行作为任务级参照，提取优化意图以指导NPU程序改写，并通过迭代性能剖析持续细化。在四类迁移工作负载上平均加速1.7倍，在27项高度优化的Modded-NanoGPT记录上接近2.0倍。该工作展示了以GPU编译证据驱动智能体式NPU训练优化的可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: We study how to improve training efficiency on Ascend NPUs. In the NPU training programs we study, framework-level compilation optimizations such as operator fusion are only partially applied, leaving fragmented computation and avoidable execution overheads. Profiling-guided tuning can address these inefficiencies, but it often requires costly trial and error. To make training on NPUs more efficient, we propose TrainBridge, an agentic approach for transferring GPU optimization guidance to NPU training. TrainBridge uses the highly optimized execution produced by mature GPU compilation stacks as a task-specific reference for NPU tuning. It extracts optimization intents from the GPU training execution to guide NPU program rewrites and further refines the rewritten program through iterative profiling. Our GPU-to-NPU migration experiments show that TrainBridge achieves an average 1.7x speedup across four workloads covering LLM pretraining, image classification, and vision-language training, and an average speedup of nearly 2.0x across 27 Modded-NanoGPT speedrun records with highly optimized GPU implementations.

papers.title_en: UlaCache: Unified Logical Addressing for Sparse LLM Serving
papers.authors: Isaac Zhu, Alan Cao, Hugh Yin, Rocky Wang, Orion Wang, Hscos Zhang, Jack Li, Jason Zhao
papers.evidence: 面向大模型服务的分布式GPU与CPU键值缓存管理
papers.tldr: 长上下文推理中，稀疏注意力虽减少计算与访存，却要求被保留的历史KV缓存持续可访问，物理位置变化也增加分布式管理复杂度。UlaCache以统一逻辑地址解耦KV分配、选择与GPU或CPU存放，并提供兼容数据并行和张量并行的访问接口；本地缓冲复用已选KV，PB-LRU并行管理共享GPU池的换出。在匹配CPU与GPU预算并启用推测解码时，其相对基线在H200最高提速1.70倍、B300最高2.51倍，提升了稀疏长上下文服务吞吐。
papers.abstract_en: Long contexts increase the memory cost of the key-value (KV) cache in large language model (LLM) inference. Sparse attention reduces attention computation and memory traffic by selecting historical tokens, but the retained KV cache must remain available for later decoding steps. We present UlaCache, a KV cache management system built around a unified logical address space spanning GPU KV pools and optional CPU memory. Stable logical references let the inference engine allocate and select KV independently of physical placement. Common allocation and sparse-access interfaces support data-parallel (DP) and tensor-parallel (TP) attention. For distributed storage, local GPU buffers retain selected KV across decoding steps, so only missing entries require transfers. When CPU storage is enabled, Parallel Bucketed LRU (PB-LRU) manages a GPU pool shared across requests. It updates recency metadata and selects eviction victims in parallel. UlaCache transfers KV and then updates the address mappings. With speculative decoding enabled under matched CPU and GPU memory budgets, UlaCache achieves peak decoding throughput speedups of 1.16 $\times$ (DP) and 1.70 $\times$ (TP) on H200, and 1.73 $\times$ (DP) and 2.51 $\times$ (TP) on B300, compared with the state-of-the-art baseline.

papers.title_en: From Classifier Heads to Encoder Prototypes: Personalized Federated Learning with Head-Derived Clustering
papers.authors: Amirardalan Dehghanpour, Arian Noori, Ehsan Tanghatari, Naimeh Omidvar, Hamid R. Rabiee
papers.evidence: 基于客户端聚类的个性化联邦训练
papers.tldr: 个性化联邦学习需判断哪些客户端应共享表征，但现有方法常引入额外训练或直接聚合不兼容模型。HDC-FL利用训练中已有的客户端分类头，低秩归一化后聚类，并为每群构建编码器原型。客户端保留私有头、接收原型软混合，无需新目标或微调。在11组CIFAR实验中，其平均精度具竞争力，并在最差客户端和后20%客户端精度上居首，说明分类头相似性可有效指导个性化共享。
papers.abstract_en: Personalized federated learning must decide which clients should share representations. We introduce HDC-FL (Head-Derived Clustering for Personalized Federated Learning), which reads that decision off a signal shared-encoder training already produces: the client-specific classifi- er heads. At periodic refresh rounds the server projects the cached heads into a normalized low-rank descriptor space, groups the descriptors, builds one encoder prototype per group from the cached client encoders, and returns to each client a soft mixture of those prototypes paired with its own unchanged head. Client-specific heads are never averaged or distributed to oth- er clients; the shared-encoder trajectory is left intact; and no second optimization trajectory, additional local objective, or post-training fine-tuning stage is required. Across 11 CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 configurations covering label-subset, Dirichlet and rotation heterogeneity with ResNet-18 and MobileNetV2 encoders, HDC-FL is competitive with the strongest personalized and clustered baselines in macro-averaged mean accuracy and attains the numerically highest macro-averaged worst-client and bottom-20% accuracy among the evaluated methods. The tail results distinguish methods that look similar when only their means are compared. A controlled donor-swap diagnostic further finds positive donor-ranking associations between head similarity and encoder compatibility in all three settings tested, most clearly under covariate shift.

papers.title_en: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
papers.authors: Panrong Tong, Quyu Kong, Pengxiang Li, Tianyu Xia, Hanzhang Zhou, Lei Wang, Chenglin Cai, Long Li, Long Chen, Jianan Zhang, Zhengwen Zeng, Xu Zhang, Gongjie Zhang, Yue Wang, Steven Hoi
papers.evidence: 支持大规模并行强化学习训练与评测的平台
papers.tldr: 在线强化学习已在数学、编程等领域取得进展，但图形界面智能体受限于交互环境昂贵、真实任务稀缺，难以规模化训练。MAI-Gym将移动端、电脑端和网页的评测、数据采集与在线强化学习整合到统一回放管线，并支持自动合成应用与可验证任务。在两万并行实例上训练的9B统一智能体，在MobileWorld和OSWorld-Verified取得78.4%和76.2%。该平台还验证模拟订票应用训练可迁移至真实手机，为可复现的大规模GUI智能体研究提供环境、任务和模型资源。
papers.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has driven rapid progress in mathematics, coding, and tool use, but scaling this success to GUI agents remains challenging due to the high cost of interactive environments and the scarcity of realistic training tasks. We introduce MAI-Gym, an open all-in-one platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online RL training across mobile, computer, and web environments. Through a shared rollout pipeline, MAI-Gym ensures consistent agent behavior across evaluation and training, supports ten established benchmarks, and scales to 20,000 parallel environment instances. Beyond scalable infrastructure, MAI-Gym enables automated synthesis of diverse GUI applications and challenging tasks, including resettable mocked apps and coherent cross-app worlds with execution-validated task verifiers. Using MAI-Gym, we train MAI-Gym-9B, a unified 9B agent for mobile and computer use, achieving state-of-the-art performance among open GUI agents under 10B parameters: 78.4% on MobileWorld and 76.2% on OSWorld-Verified. Importantly, RL in a mocked train-ticketing app transfers to its real-world counterpart, improving task success on a phys- ical phone from 28.8% to 48.1%. We release the framework, synthesis skills, mocked apps, 2,000 verified tasks, and the model checkpoint to support repro- ducible research and further advances in scalable GUI agent training.

papers.title_en: Water-Energy-Data nexus reveals sustainability gaps and priorities for AI infrastructure
papers.authors: Jincheng Huang, Guoan Xiao, Xin Lan, Caichun Yin, Zhimeng Jiang, Yue Cui, Jianguo Liu
papers.evidence: 面向AI基础设施的全生命周期可持续性框架
papers.tldr: 人工智能基础设施的扩张连接矿产、芯片、数据中心和电子废弃物处理，其水、能与数据依赖跨越地区和全生命周期，却常被割裂评估。研究提出水—能源—数据纽带框架，并借助大语言模型汇总12,825篇相关文献。证据图谱显示，现有研究偏重数据中心运行能耗，对用水、间接需求及跨地点传导关注不足。该框架揭示资源压力与责任可能在节点和区域间转移，为识别AI可持续性缺口和治理优先级提供整合基础。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) depends on interconnected water, energy, and data systems spanning infrastructure life cycles and diverse geographies, with the potential to intensify water and energy insecurity, exacerbate social inequities and lead to cascading sustainability issues globally. Yet assessments commonly examine them separately, limiting our understanding of where resource pressures arise, how they are transferred across space, and who bears their consequences. To address these challenges, we established a water-energy-data (WED) nexus framework that captures the spatial and life-cycle dependencies of AI infrastructure, and use large language models to synthesize 12,825 water- or energy-related studies across four resource-intensive AI infrastructure activities: mineral extraction, semiconductor manufacturing, data center operation and electronic-waste processing. The evidence map identifies a mismatch between the interconnected activities supporting AI infrastructure and boundaries used to assess them. Researchers assess operational energy more than water use and other indirect demands, while interactions across locations and life-cycle activities remain understudied. These gaps obscure how resource demands shift among infrastructure nodes and regions, and how data-enabled benefits compare with their underlying costs. The WED nexus provides a foundation for integrated assessment of spatially metacoupled systems, while the evidence map can inform priorities for managing the sustainability implications of the AI boom.

papers.title_en: Mining the Self-Rewriting System: A Vision for Data Mining on AI-Native Infrastructure
papers.authors: Mayank Darbari, Chiman Salavati, Liang Wu, Dawei Wang, Jiong Zhang, Kelly Wan, Krishna Chakka, Liangjie Hong
papers.evidence: 面向AI原生基础设施的系统级数据挖掘
papers.tldr: 传统数据挖掘默认数据由学习器外部产生，但AI原生基础设施中，智能体的观测、行动、检索更新与模型发布会反向改写后续训练和评估数据。论文将其定义为“自我改写系统”及内生漂移。核心主张是，仅看各表面的边际监控信号，通常无法识别跨表面故障原因，必须联合分析。文章据此提出漂移归因、演化轨迹挖掘、知识织物维护和统一评估闸门四项议程，并规划基准与评价标准。
papers.abstract_en: Classical data mining treats data as generated outside the learner. Emerging AI-native infrastructure invalidates this assumption: as agents observe system state, act, update retrieval stores and models, and promote new artifacts into the serving path, their own decisions reshape the future logs, traces, corpora, and evaluation records used for later training and release. We call this new research object a self-rewriting system and the resulting system-induced distribution shift endogenous drift. Our central, falsifiable claim is that cross-surface causes are not identifiable in general from marginal per-surface monitoring: different coupled failures can produce the same individual signals while differing in their joint behavior, requiring joint analysis for reliable attribution. This agenda comprises four foundational research problems: fusing heterogeneous drift signals into calibrated gating and attribution (C1); mining agent traces whose activity alphabet evolves (C2); maintaining knowledge fabrics through online reindexing, faithfulness, and compression decisions (C3); and safely promoting concurrent learning streams through one shared evaluation gate (C4). These remain fragmented across concept drift, performative prediction, process mining, streaming retrieval-augmented generation, and MLOps, without a unified data-mining agenda. We outline public benchmarks and evaluation criteria, using AI-native telecom only as a motivating exemplar with analogues in finance, software CI/CD, and clinical decision support.

papers.title_en: Communication-Efficient Federated Domain Generalization in Edge Networks via Dynamic Prototype Regulation
papers.authors: Yuankun Xia, Hui Wang, Ling Yuan, Ziyu Hong, Di Yin, Yufeng Zhou
papers.evidence: 面向边缘视觉语言模型的通信高效联邦分布式训练
papers.tldr: 面向带宽受限、衰落显著的物联网边缘联邦学习，视觉语言模型的大参数上传延迟与非独立同分布数据导致的客户端漂移共同限制跨域泛化。论文提出DPGR-GCAM，以双参数高效微调降低更新规模，并按信道状态分层截断传输载荷。其GCAM在低维特征流形中调节梯度冲突，减少额外计算及超时掉线。实验表明，在仅10%客户端参与和信道衰落下，方法仍保持收敛并提升跨域泛化，兼顾通信可靠性与训练效果。
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is a distributed paradigm for Internet of Things (IoT) edge networks. However, deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) over wireless edge networks presents distinct challenges: large model parameters increase uplink transmission latency over bandwidth-constrained fading channels, and non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) data exacerbates client drift. Existing feature alignment solutions often introduce auxiliary computations that consume time slots allocated for wireless parameter transmission, increasing the likelihood of straggler dropouts under system delay constraints. To address these issues, we propose DPGR-GCAM, a communication-efficient federated domain generalization framework. By employing a dual-parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) architecture, we design a channel-aware tiered transmission mechanism that adaptively truncates payloads to maximize node survival rates under fading conditions. To mitigate client drift, we introduce the Gradient-Conflict Aware Modulation (GCAM) mechanism. GCAM operates within the low-dimensional feature manifold to dynamically resolve multi-objective optimization conflicts with minimal edge computation latency, thereby reducing computation-induced network outages. Experiments demonstrate that DPGR-GCAM improves cross-domain generalization and sustains convergence under network fading scenarios with a 10\% client participation rate.

papers.title_en: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
papers.authors: Shangheng Du, Jinxin Shi, Shuaiyu Zhang, Yiming Wu, Junpeng Zhao, Shiyang Feng, Xin Li, Liang He, Xiangchao Yan, Bo Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向自主机器学习工程的智能体编排
papers.tldr: 长程机器学习工程需反复运行昂贵实验，单次反馈又对应多项先前决策，使智能体难从长轨迹学习。论文训练35B混合专家模型MLExpert，以Kaggle-MLE Factory构造任务，结合分层监督微调和窗口交互强化学习，将相邻实验结果间决策共享结果奖励。MLE-Bench Lite上，平均获奖率由37.9%升至72.7%，接近更大前沿模型，并泛化提升科学、脚手架和算法优化。该工作验证了中间结果驱动的长程自主优化后训练。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. Further experiments show that MLExpert improves performance on NatureBench Lite, agent scaffold optimization, and algorithm optimization, suggesting that the learned optimization capability generalizes to other tasks.

papers.title_en: Noise-shaped Sampling and Annealing for Scalable On-the-edge Training of Binary and Ternary AI Models
papers.authors: Zihao Chen, Zhili Xiao, Rui-Jie Zhu, Yipeng Wang, Jason Eshraghian, Shantanu Chakrabartty
papers.evidence: 面向低比特人工智能模型的可扩展高效训练方法
papers.tldr: 二值和三值网络的离散权重训练可等价为分层高阶伊辛能量优化，但固定能量求基态与追求泛化并不相同。论文提出ΣΔ采样器，将随机采样退火量化器置于一阶ΣΔ噪声整形环中。该机制把量化、高阶挫折及小批量噪声移出低频适应带，使更新贴近平滑下降轨迹。在视觉、持续学习和27亿参数语言模型上验证，并显著降低训练内存与更新访存，面向端侧训练。
papers.abstract_en: The training loss of binary and ternary neural networks, expanded as a multilinear polynomial over the discrete weights, is structurally equivalent to the energy of a hierarchical high-order Ising model. We exploit this equivalence to apply Ising solvers to discrete-weight network training, while accounting for a fundamental difference in objectives: an Ising solver seeks the ground state of a fixed energy function, whereas training seeks solutions that generalize to unseen data. Our key contribution is $ΣΔ$-Sampler, an optimizer that reconciles these objectives by embedding a stochastic sampling-and-annealing step as a noisy quantizer inside a first-order $ΣΔ$ noise-shaping loop. The loop pushes noise from weight quantization, high-order frustration, and mini-batch sampling out of the low-frequency adaptation band, so that discrete weight updates follow the smooth descent trajectories embedded in the rugged loss landscape. We validate the framework on a planted quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) benchmark with a known minimizer; on CIFAR-10, where a $13$M-parameter ternary model comes within $1\%$ of full-precision accuracy; on ImageNet-1k, where a ternary ResNet-18 comes within $0.4\%$ Top-5 accuracy of a ternary baseline; on class-incremental continual learning, where prior-task accuracy is preserved; and on MatMul-free language models up to $2.7$B parameters, where it outperforms a straight-through-estimator baseline under matched continued pre-training. Compared with standard quantization-aware training, $ΣΔ$-Sampler reduces the training memory footprint by over $50\%$, delivers an order-of-magnitude speed-up, and reduces weight-update memory traffic by four orders of magnitude, making it attractive for on-device training and fine-tuning of large binary and ternary models.

papers.title_en: FedRAPP: Federated Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models with Reliability-Aware Prompt Personalization
papers.authors: Syed Md. Ahnaf Hasan, Md Akil Raihan Iftee, Sajib Mistry, Amin Ahsan Ali, AKM Mahbubur Rahman
papers.evidence: 面向异构分布式客户端的联邦测试时提示适配
papers.tldr: 现有联邦提示学习依赖带标签数据，难以应对无源、无标签测试流中客户端间显著的非独立同分布偏移；各端独立调优的软提示会发生方向各异的漂移，常规聚合因而失效。FedRAPP以可靠性评估筛选客户端，结合服务器端指数滑动平均提示记忆及相似度引导的同伴聚合，在保留本地专长的同时吸收兼容知识。九个CLIP基准及ImageNet变体实验显示，其在异质分布下稳定优于标准联邦聚合，并保持仅调优提示的高效率。
papers.abstract_en: Federated prompt learning enables vision-language models like CLIP to collaboratively adapt lightweight soft prompts across distributed clients without sharing raw data. However, existing federated prompt learning methods are designed primarily for supervised settings with labeled client data and assumed relatively stable training distributions. At test time, source-free federated prompt tuning remains largely unexplored. Clients may receive unlabeled target samples with heterogeneous, often non-IID distributions that differ substantially across clients and from the source training distribution, causing locally adapted prompts to drift in different directions and reducing the effectiveness of federated aggregation. In this work, we explore Source-Free Federated Test-Time Prompt Tuning (SF-FTTPT), where distributed clients collaboratively adapt soft prompts on unlabeled test streams without access to source data. Our study reveals that conventional federated aggregation methods struggle under heterogeneous client distributions, as locally adapted prompts become increasingly specialized and difficult to combine effectively. To address this challenge, we propose FedRAPP, a personalized aggregation framework that combines reliability-aware client assessment, server-side exponential moving-average prompt memory, and similarity-guided peer aggregation. FedRAPP selectively incorporates information from reliable and compatible clients while preserving local specialization, enabling more robust adaptation under distribution shift. Extensive experiments across nine CLIP benchmark datasets and ImageNet variants demonstrate that FedRAPP consistently outperforms standard federated aggregation baselines under heterogeneous client distributions while maintaining the efficiency advantages of prompt-only adaptation.
